decisions.reason: Metro connectivity between data centres is central to the firm's fibre and carrier-neutral data centre strategy and has proven adoption in financial hubs.
Optical spectrum services make use of owned fibre and meet rising high-bandwidth demand, which fits the firm's direction toward integrated, high-capacity infrastructure.
The self-service number ordering portal supports real-time provisioning of SIP and cloud voice and is cheap to run, though it could be folded into a broader customer portal.
Carrier pre-selection is a shrinking legacy service as networks move to all-IP, but remaining customers still bring revenue, so a phased run-down is more likely than withdrawal within the year.
Direct voice network connections stay relevant for enterprises and service providers moving to SIP and cloud communications platforms.
